Subject: Co-sell demo runbook: compressing SI + marketplace walkthrough

Hi Amit / Cloudstride schedulers —

Quick ask: ACME (ProdOps) would like a single consolidated run-through that covers the end-to-end SI integration plus the Marketplace onboarding flow. Right now we have two separate 60-minute slots (SI technical + Marketplace ops). To reduce churn on their side we want to compress to one 90-minute session with clear handoffs and a brief rehearsal the day before.

Proposed agenda (attached runbook-outline.pdf):
- 0–10: introductions, success criteria (redwood + cloudstride + ACME)
- 10–35: SI technical deep-dive (networking, instance sizing, model selection)
- 35–60: Marketplace integration + provisioning demo
- 60–75: Joint troubleshooting / Q&A (cross-team)
- 75–90: Next steps / action owners + signoff

Preferred window: Tue Nov 23 or Thu Nov 25, US-Pacific afternoon (1–4pm PT). If those are tight, Wed Nov 24 10–11:30 PT could work. Can you confirm Cloudstride facilitator availability and whether you need an extra hour to set up lab accounts?

Attachments: runbook-outline.pdf, agenda-proposal.xlsx

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Sr. Partner Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Subject: Re: Co-sell demo runbook: compressing SI + marketplace walkthrough

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the clear agenda and runbook — much appreciated. Cloudstride can support a consolidated 90-minute slot but a couple of constraints: our lead systems engineer (Ravi) is booked on Nov 23 morning and afternoon; Nov 24 (Wed) 10–11:30 PT would work but we would need to start at 09:45 PT for a 90-minute contiguous block to allow time for environment prep. Alternatively, Nov 25 after 2pm PT is open for us.

Two notes:
- We recommend a 30-minute pre-demo rehearsal (lightweight) the day before with the facilitator and one SME from each org.
- For the marketplace provisioning demo we'll need a temporary test listing and a sandbox token from Redwood — can you confirm we have a sandbox token and the shared drive link with the installer?

Attaching: pre-demo-checklist.md (stub).

Best,
Amit Shah
